title: Remove duplicates from a Python list
text: For hashable values, list(dict.fromkeys(values)) removes duplicates while preserving first occurrence order. For unhashable values, use an equality-based loop or a stable key.

title: Latest row per group with SQL
text: Use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC), then keep row number 1 in an outer query. The second ordering column makes ties deterministic.

title: Python mutable default arguments
text: Default argument expressions are evaluated when the function is defined. A list default can be reused across calls. Use None as the default and create a fresh list inside the function when the argument is None.

title: Parameterized SQL queries
text: Bind untrusted values as query parameters rather than concatenating them into SQL. Parameters represent values, not identifiers. Select dynamic table or column identifiers from a fixed allowlist.

title: Blocking work in an async endpoint
text: Blocking I/O in an async function blocks its event loop unless moved to a worker thread or replaced with an async client. CPU-heavy work usually needs a process or external worker.
